blockers.description: CR-01: Hall preset + real audio produces output pinned at ~-5 dBFS independent of input level (tested 0, -12, -24 dBFS inputs — same output peak), then abrupt cliff from -5 dBFS to -48 dBFS at second 5. Signature of self-oscillating feedback / saturation-pinned loop, not proper Hall decay. Suspected causes: mix-bus aliasing (reverb reads raw 44.1 kHz samples via state->mix_bus_l/r without antialiasing), internal sat_s16 saturation in comb/APF feedback stages, possibly other DSP correctness bugs that shipped uncaught through Phases 3-5.
